Step 1: join duck hunt legacy era

Step 3: enjoy your towers
scripts.script:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local InteractItem = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("InteractItem")
local TroopsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Assets"):WaitForChild("Troops")

local function buyTower(towerName)
    local args = { towerName }
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        InteractItem:InvokeServer(unpack(args))
    end)
    if success then
        print("Bought tower:", towerName)
    else
        warn("Failed to buy tower:", towerName, err)
    end
end

for _, tower in ipairs(TroopsFolder:GetChildren()) do
    buyTower(tower.Name)
    task.wait(0.2)
end
